title: List Unhealthy GCE Instances
description: Read-only JSON list of the VMs in one zone of the project that are not RUNNING (e.g. REPAIRING, STAGING, TERMINATED) or that carry an upcomingMaintenance notice. Fields: `name`, `id` (the same value as the node annotation `container.googleapis.com/instance_id`), `status`, `creationTimestamp` and `resourceStatus.upcomingMaintenance{maintenanceStatus, type, windowStartTime}`. Covers every VM of the project in that zone, not only one workload's nodes. Run it asynchronously and at most every 5 min. timeout_seconds is 180 because the source measured ~48 s for this filtered list (~75 s for a full list). A FAILURE_INFRA maintenance window that keeps reopening while the VM stays RUNNING is a stale notice: the host has a known fault and may be taken down at any time.
instruction: gcloud compute instances list --quiet --project=${project_id} --filter="zone:(${zone}) AND (status!=RUNNING OR resourceStatus.upcomingMaintenance:*)" --format="json(name,id,status,creationTimestamp,resourceStatus.upcomingMaintenance)"

fallback.reason: Query Cloud Logging GCE system_event audit logs by zone when compute.instances.list is denied or times out.

zone.description: Zone to list. A project can hold TPU capacity in several zones; run once per zone.
